features.name: Class Skills
features.description:
A gladiator gains Perform (act, comedy, and dance) (Cha) as class skills.

features.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
features.description:
A gladiator is not proficient with heavy armor or tower shields. Instead, he gains the [Performance Weapon Mastery](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/feats/combat-feats/performance-weapon-mastery-combat/) feat at 1st level as a bonus feat. Furthermore, a gladiator using piecemeal armor is considered to be wearing a suit of armor as long as he wearing two or three armor pieces, gaining the +1 to armor bonus but still taking the +5% chance of spell failure if the pieces are mixed.

features.name: Gladiator Style
features.description:
At 1st level, the gladiator selects one of the following styles, representing his formal style. The gladiator may ignore prerequisites when selecting a bonus feat from his style, whether through this ability, bonus feats as a gladiator, or general feat selection.

* *Armored:* The gladiator reduces the armor check penalty of any armor worn by 1 and increases the max Dex bonus to AC by 1.
* *Beast-warrior:* The gladiator gains the [Power Attack](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/feats/combat-feats/power-attack-combat/) feat. In addition, he gains a +2 bonus on attack rolls against animals and magical beasts.
* *Blade and* *S**hield:* The gladiator gains [Improved Shield Bash](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/feats/combat-feats/improved-shield-bash-combat/) or [Two-Weapon Fighting](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/feats/combat-feats/two-weapon-fighting-combat/) as a bonus feat. The gladiator reduces the armor check penalty of any shield by 2.
* *Dual* *B**lade:* The gladiator gains [Two-Weapon Fighting](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/feats/combat-feats/two-weapon-fighting-combat/) as a bonus feat.
* *Executioner:* The gladiator gains [Power Attack](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/feats/combat-feats/power-attack-combat/) as a bonus feat. In addition, he treats all proficient weapons as [deadly](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/magic-items/magic-weapons/magic-weapon-special-abilities/deadly/).
* *Exotic:* The gladiator gains [Exotic Weapon Proficiency](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/feats/combat-feats/exotic-weapon-proficiency-combat/) as a bonus feat.
* *Net and Trident:* The gladiator gains [Exotic Weapon Proficiency](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/feats/combat-feats/exotic-weapon-proficiency-combat/) (net) and can throw it one-handed.
* *Technical:* The gladiator gains [Improved Grapple](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/feats/combat-feats/improved-grapple-combat/) as a bonus feat.

This ability replaces combat defences.

features.name: Uncanny Dodge
features.description:
Starting at 2nd level, a gladiator can react to danger before his senses would normally allow him to do so. He cannot be caught flat-footed, even if the attacker is invisible. He still loses his Dexterity bonus to AC if immobilized. A gladiator with this ability can still lose his Dexterity bonus to AC if an opponent successfully uses the feint action against him. If a gladiator already has uncanny dodge from a different class, he automatically gains improved uncanny dodge (see below) instead.

This ability replaces combat offenses.

features.name: Fame
features.description:
At 2nd level, when a gladiator begins a performance combat, he always starts with at least 1 victory point. If he already has victory points, he gains 1 extra victory point. At 10th level, the gladiator starts out with at least 2 victory points. If he already has victory points, he gains 2 extra victory points.

This ability replaces a warrior talent gained at 2nd level.

features.name: Improved Uncanny Dodge
features.description:
At 5th level and higher, a gladiator can no longer be flanked. This defense denies a thief the ability to sneak attack the gladiator by flanking him, unless the attacker has at least four more thief levels than the target has warrior levels. If a character already has uncanny dodge (see above) from another class, the levels from the classes that grant uncanny dodge stack to determine the minimum thief level required to flank the character.

This ability replaces weapon guard.

features.name: Improved Gladiator Style
features.description:
At 6th level, the gladiator gains an additional ability, based on his style. The gladiator may ignore prerequisites when selecting a bonus feat from his style, whether through this ability, bonus feats as a gladiator, or general feat selection.

* *Armored:* The gladiator may move at normal speed in medium armor. In addition, he reduces the armor check penalty of worn armor by 1.
* *Beast-warrior:* The gladiator gains [Lunge](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/feats/combat-feats/lunge-combat/), [Stand Still](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/feats/combat-feats/stand-still-combat/), or [Weapon Focus](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/feats/combat-feats/weapon-focus-combat/) (any melee weapon) as a bonus feat. He also gains the ability of wild empathy, as a ranger.
* *Blade and* *S**hield:* The gladiator gains [Improved Shield Bash](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/feats/combat-feats/improved-shield-bash-combat/), [Two-Weapon Fighting](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/feats/combat-feats/two-weapon-fighting-combat/), or [Shield Focus](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/feats/combat-feats/shield-focus-combat/) as a bonus feat. Once per day, when wearing a light or heavy shield, the gladiator may make a bull rush as a [free action](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#free) after performing a full attack.
* *Dual* *B**lade:* The gladiator gains [Double Slice](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/feats/combat-feats/double-slice-combat/), [Improved Two-Weapon Fighting](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/feats/combat-feats/improved-two-weapon-fighting-combat/), or [Weapon Focus](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/feats/combat-feats/weapon-focus-combat/) (any melee weapon) as a bonus feat. He can treat any one-handed heavy or light blade (as per the warrior weapon training groups) as a light weapon.
* *Executioner:* The gladiator gains [Cleave](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/feats/combat-feats/cleave-combat/), [Dazzling Display](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/feats/combat-feats/dazzling-display-combat/), or [Weapon Focus](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/feats/combat-feats/weapon-focus-combat/) (any melee weapon) as a bonus feat. The first time he damages an enemy with a melee attack each round, he gains a +2 bonus to Intimidate checks for 1 round.
* *Exotic:* The gladiator gains [Dazzling Display](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/feats/combat-feats/dazzling-display-combat/), [Power Attack](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/feats/combat-feats/power-attack-combat/), or [Weapon Focus](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/feats/combat-feats/weapon-focus-combat/) as a bonus feat. He gains a +2 CMD against attempts to disarm him.
* *Net and Trident:* The gladiator gains [Lunge](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/feats/combat-feats/lunge-combat/), [Two-Weapon Fighting](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/feats/combat-feats/two-weapon-fighting-combat/), or [Weapon Finesse](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/feats/combat-feats/weapon-finesse-combat/) as a bonus feat. He can treat a shortspear or trident as a light weapon.
* *Technical:* The gladiator gains [Improved Disarm](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/feats/combat-feats/improved-disarm-combat/), [Improved Overrun](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/feats/combat-feats/improved-overrun-combat/), or [Step-Up](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/feats/combat-feats/step-up-combat/) as a bonus feat. His Dex bonus to AC is increased by +1; note that Dex bonus to AC is limited by armor worn.

This ability replaces robust physique.

features.name: Defensive Roll
features.description:
A gladiator of at least 15th level can roll with a potentially lethal blow to take less damage from it than he otherwise would. Once per day, when he would be reduced to 0 or fewer hit points by damage in combat (from a weapon or other blow, not a spell or special ability), the gladiator can attempt to roll with the damage. To use this ability, the gladiator must attempt a Reflex saving throw (DC = damage dealt). If the save succeeds, he takes only half damage from the blow; if it fails, he takes full damage. He must be aware of the attack and able to react to it in order to execute his defensive roll —if he is denied his Dexterity bonus to AC, he can’t use this ability. Since this effect would not normally allow a character to make a Reflex save for half damage, the evasion ability does not apply to the defensive roll.

This ability replaces unstoppable strike.

features.name: Arena King/Queen
features.description:
At 20th level, the gladiator becomes a champion of death and glory. Any time he is affected by a morale bonus of any kind, he gains +4 luck bonus on Will saves. Whenever he threatens an opponent with a melee weapon, he gains a +4 dodge bonus to AC.

This ability replaces a warrior advanced talent gained at 20th level.
